title: What Zero-Waste Fashion Systems Is
definition: Zero-Waste Fashion Systems: fashion with no cutting waste.
description:
Zero-Waste Fashion Systems — Signature Edition: fashion with no cutting waste. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature system hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: pattern algorithms rethought, system logistics rebuilt, whole-garment knit reimagined for the century ahead. title: The Signature Vision: Zero-Waste Fashion Systems
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Zero-Waste Fashion Systems.
description:

Signature system hulls program, charter one: master pattern algorithms at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale system logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate whole-garment knit systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Zero-Waste Fashion Systems becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: Readiness Estimator: Zero-Waste Fashion Systems
definition: Estimates Zero-Waste Fashion Systems readiness from component maturity.

Honest scoring is the point: a system hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Zero-Waste Fashion Systems operating for a day.
description:

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where pattern algorithms monitoring, system logistics redundancy, or whole-garment knit maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Zero-Waste Fashion Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Zero-Waste Fashion Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Zero-Waste Fashion Systems — fashion with no cutting waste.

Phase 1 — Prove (pattern algorithms): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (system logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (whole-garment knit): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (take-back): system hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and fashion-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
